items.title: Charles Schwab to Expand Crypto Offering for Clients. What to Know.
items.summary: When Schwab started allowing customers to hold and trade cryptocurrencies directly in May, it limited their options to the two largest assets by market capitalization: Bitcoin and Ethereum.  “With this expansion, clients will have more choices to build a digital asset allocation alongside the investing and banking experience they know and trust at Schwab,” said Joe Vietri, head of digital assets at Schwab.  Shares of Schwab were down 1.3% Thursday morning.

items.title: Charles Schwab (SCHW) Opens Digital Account API To Third Party Fintechs
items.summary: Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) has launched its Digital Account Opening API, now live through wealth management platform OneVest. The new API supports digital onboarding for advisors and enterprise clients that use OneVest. The rollout expands Schwab's third party fintech integration options and broadens distribution for its custody and platform services. items.title: Vanguard Takes On Fidelity, Charles Schwab With $4 Billion Altruist Deal
items.summary: Vanguard bolsters its wealth custody, advisory offerings with a reported $4 billion acquisition for AI-forward platform Altruist.

items.title: Vanguard to Buy Wealth Platform Altruist. It’s Going After a Business Schwab and Fidelity Dominate.
items.summary: Vanguard’s Altruist acquisition may advance its goal of drumming up more business with independent financial advisors, one of the fastest growing areas of wealth management.

items.title: Wealth Management Stocks Fall After Vanguard Aquires Tech Platform
items.summary: Vanguard's ambition to expand in financial advice is causing some trepidation among investors in the industry's incumbents.  Shares of Charles Schwab and LPL Financial were off more than 2% in morning trading Wednesday after Vanguard announced the acquisition of Altruist, a fintech wealth management platform.  Altruist competes with Schwab to custody assets on behalf of financial advisers, and offers AI tools for tax and financial planning.
